heading: Ending 0: Fatally injured
text: You succumb to your injuries. Your journey ends here, hero.

heading: Ending 1: Too tired to fight
text: During your battle with the Demon King, exhaustion catches up with you, leaving you vulnerable. Seizing the opportunity, the Demon King strikes you down. Your quest ends here, Hero.

heading: Ending 2: Defeated
text: You lack the relics needed to stand against the Demon King. Despite your best efforts, you are defeated in battle. Your quest has failed, Hero.

heading: Ending 3: Victory
text: With your skill and the power of the holy relics, you overpower the Demon King and emerge victorious! You have completed your quest. Congratulations, Hero!

heading: Ending 4: True harmony
text: With all five relics in your possession, the people cheering you on, and your strength at its peak, you overwhelm the Demon King and claim decisive victory.
But just as you prepare to deliver your final blow, the Demon King drops to one knee.
"Your strength, your skill, your noble heart... I've never met anyone quite like you."
It takes your hand.
"Hero, will you marry me?"

heading: Ending 4: True harmony
text:
Through your marriage with the Demon King, you've finally achieved peace between humans and demons.

Congratulations, Hero. Our world has achieved true harmony thanks to you.

Also... happy marriage!
